summary.intent: Execute the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone), followed by executing the first 4 waves of the execute-phase workflow autonomously while the user was AFK.
summary.outcome: Phase 62 was fully planned (9 plans across 7 waves, verified 15/15 dimensions) and execution completed through Wave 4 (6/9 plans done), with the core codec complete, frozen golden vectors committed, old folder/file types deleted, core dist built, and sdk-core compile-gate in progress.

repo: Phase 62 is the v2.0 keystone: unified Node codec replacing legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata types, with dual-sealed bodies and generation-as-AAD across packages/core, sdk-core, sdk, and web.
Wave structure is strictly dependency-ordered: core→sdk-core→sdk→web (each package needs the prior package's dist/ before it can typecheck).

file-ipns.test.ts imported from retired folder/ and file/ modules (FileMetadata, FolderMetadata, FolderEntry), so its deletion was correct — live IPNS behavior is tested in ipns.test.ts and ipns-record.test.ts which remain.
Retired type names (FolderMetadata, FilePointer) appearing in core source grep results were all migration comments, not live imports — core tsc clean confirms zero live references.
The gsd commit helper can report commit_failed while the commit actually lands (git log confirms) — a known false-negative in the tooling.
workflow.auto_advance=true in config would normally chain plan-phase into execute-phase automatically; suppressed here for the keystone phase pending user confirmation.
plan:pre hooks active for this phase: intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate (contribution), tdd (contribution), drift (non-blocking). Security and UI gates inactive.
Drift precheck flagged 143 pre-existing elements (Feb .learnings/, landing/, root configs) — map is stale/missing, not a Phase 62 issue; non-blocking.
Core test count: 211 (post-Wave1) → 228 (post-Wave2, golden vectors added) → 190 (post-Wave3, folder-metadata.test.ts + file-ipns.test.ts retired = -38).
VALIDATION.md is created from RESEARCH.md Validation Architecture section when Nyquist validation is enabled — this happens between research and planning steps.
PATTERNS.md is not committed by step 13d (which only commits PLAN/STATE/ROADMAP) — must be committed explicitly after pattern-mapper runs.

code.finding: New unified Node/SealedChildRef/PublishedNode types created here in Wave 1 (Plan 62-01), replacing legacy folder/metadata.ts and file/metadata.ts types.
Barrel cutover in Plan 62-05: dropped exports for folder/ and file/, now exports node/ only.

Committed cross-language golden vector for vault v3 blob (two-key layout: 0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey)). Required in external file per D-04 for Rust parity, not inline in plan.
Frozen Node wire format golden vectors (body-bytes primary lock + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock). Reuses Phase-61 node_id/IV so Phase-69 Rust test slots in directly.
Adapted in Plan 62-05 to compile against Node: nodeRef?: Node added, behavioral logic stubbed to throw new Error('not implemented — phase NN') for phase 65.

workflow: Sequential execution on the main worktree (not parallel worktrees) is the right call for a pnpm monorepo with a cross-package dist chain — worktrees lack node_modules and require per-worktree pnpm install.

Plan-checker iteration 1 caught 1 blocker + 4 warnings; all were targeted fixes (RESOLVED markers, vector file location, exit-code-safe tsc invocations, plan size threshold). Plan 08 split into 08a/08b to stay under context limit for autonomous execution.
The plan-checker's blocker was RESEARCH.md missing (RESOLVED) markers — a gate requirement, not a content issue. Resolutions already existed, just not annotated.

grep-based discovery of web test files referencing retired types is more reliable than a static list — web quarantine in Plan 08 uses grep at execution time rather than enumerating files at planning time.
partial-tsc verifies should use exit-code capture (set -e or PIPESTATUS) rather than trailing echo to avoid masking failures in automated/unsupervised execution.
The drift precheck being non-blocking (spawn_mapper: false) means planning proceeds even with a stale codebase map — /gsd-map-codebase can refresh it independently.
API-surface intel regenerating 0 symbols means it carries no value for the planner prompt and should be omitted rather than included as an empty section.
The --no-transition flag on execute-phase stops the workflow from auto-chaining into Phase 63 after completion, appropriate for the v2.0 keystone requiring human review before proceeding.

friction: gsd commit helper reported commit_failed for the VALIDATION.md commit (2475ae35d) but git log confirmed it landed — a known false-negative that required manual verification to avoid a duplicate commit.
Node eval in the worktree-mode detection script had a quoting bug, requiring a manual re-extraction of init values.

Drift precheck flagged 143 elements as stale but they were all pre-existing (Feb files, landing/, root configs) with no Phase 62 relevance — the map baseline is missing/old, producing noisy non-actionable output.
The requirements-coverage display had a word-splitting glitch (all six NODE IDs printed as one token), requiring a clean re-run to confirm the result.
